style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: he never stops: at a dead sprint from the first frame to 4.9, then flying low, the camera racing backwards ahead of him so the walls tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; loose notes wipe the lens every beat; he fills half the frame height, chest up from 7.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a tall pink flamingo in a grey banker waistcoat, long black beak, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean flamingo teller in a green visor sprinting at the lens all clip, flinging notes
props: two notes of the same size the teller flings: the first a green dollar bill, a huge 100 and a $; the second a russian hundred rouble note, pale beige and olive, a chariot with four horses engraved above a columned theatre portico, a huge 100 and a ₽; loose notes gusting past his legs
prop_continuity: the notes fly until his beak takes them; the four horses, the 100 and the ₽ stay readable on the beige note; only it crumples; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow corridor, bricks of banknotes filling both walls to the ceiling, violet then green then blue

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.1 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: bank-NO-ty, o-di-NA-ko-vy-e, ha-RAK-ter, u fto-ROY, MYAG-che
audio.pacing: 0.0-2.2 one breath; pause 2.2-6.4; 6.4-8.4 one breath; after 8.4 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his beak opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: footfalls to 4.9 then wingbeats, paper storm, a sheet metal ring at 2.4, a squelch at 4.4, a scrubbing rustle 5.6-6.4, a roll unspooling at 8.4

timeline.a: the frame opens on him already at a dead sprint, violet bricks tearing past, the teller sprinting in at his shoulder with the green note and the beige one
the teller flicks both notes spinning side by side, the same huge 100 flashing on both, and he runs on under them
he snaps the green dollar out of the air in his beak at a full run and it stays board stiff, ringing like sheet metal past the lens
the teller flings the beige note in spinning, four horses and ₽ turning over on it, past blue bricks
he snaps the beige note the same way mid-run and his beak sinks straight through it, the paper going limp
he throws his wings open into low flight and catches the limp note off his beak between both feet, bricks tearing past under him
close on both feet in flight, scrubbing the beige note the way you soften newspaper, the four horses crumpling fluffy as toilet paper, walls streaking behind
he shakes the shaggy beige note at the lens in flight, the 100 and the ₽ readable on it
chest-up, face to camera, still flying, the fluffed beige note hanging off one foot as the walls streak behind
the note unspools off his foot into a ribbon of toilet paper printed over and over with the same beige hundred, four horses and 100 ₽ repeating, past the lens
he flies straight at the lens, the ribbon streaming after him

must_appear: the first note is a green dollar, the second a beige rouble note with four horses and a ₽; at 4.4 his beak sinks through the beige one; from 5.6 both feet scrub only that one fluffy as toilet paper; at 8.4 it unspools into a toilet paper ribbon of 100 ₽
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic panel, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, a parked camera, a still background, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a hero flying away from the lens, a held pose, slow motion, cyrillic letters, a green second note, speech after 8.4
